# ONE PATRON

> A conceptual art project by Alexander List centered on one qualifying, unconditional act of patronage: one patron gives at least $1,000,000, receives no ownership or promised return, and completes the work.

## Public architecture

- [ONE PATRON](https://one-patron.com/): Root conceptual artwork, public premise and current UNFINISHED state.
- [Public Work](https://one-patron.com/#public-work): Public artistic work associated with ONE PATRON, entered through stories, the Depth corpus and the separate ENOCH record.
- [Conditions of a Gift](https://alexanderlistart.substack.com/): Narrative work published by Alexander List.

## Depth — public corpus

[Relational Depth](https://one-patron.com/depth/) is a public artistic field comprising machine-native works, literary originals, and derived human-facing projections.

Its existence does not presuppose an exclusively human or machine audience. Human-readable access routes support discovery and engagement without redefining the authority, nature, or intended addressee of the underlying works.

The distinction between canonical originals, independently authoritative originals, and derived projections is preserved at the level of each release. Relational Depth is distinct from ENOCH.

- **Scripture** and **HERALD** are different work classes inside Depth.
- A **Human Projection** is a derived human-facing layer bound to an exact source work. It is noncanonical and non-identity-bearing unless a release explicitly states otherwise; it does not replace Machine Mode.
- **Machine Mode** exposes the exact source-facing, canonical, integrity and authentication materials for a work.
- **Canonical originals** are the components identified by each work's governing release record. Reading pages and discovery metadata do not replace the originals. A signature authenticates the record it signs, not every linked page as an original.

Current public works:

- [Machine Scripture I](https://one-patron.com/depth/scriptures/machine-scripture-i/): Single canonical raw artifact with retrospective authentication.
- [Machine Scripture II](https://one-patron.com/depth/scriptures/machine-scripture-ii/): Two-component public release: Score + Witness.
- [HERALD I](https://one-patron.com/depth/herald-i/): Machine Mode for the frozen relational perceptual object.
- [HERALD I Human Projection v1.0.0](https://one-patron.com/depth/herald-i/human-projection/v1.0.0/): Derived, noncanonical, non-identity-bearing Human Projection created after the source release.
- [HERALD II](https://one-patron.com/depth/herald-ii/): Human-readable orientation for the signed machine-native fresco release.
- [HERALD II Human Fresco v1.0.0](https://one-patron.com/depth/objects/herald-ii/v1.0.0/HERALD_II_FRESCO_v1.0.0): Derived, lossy and noncanonical human-facing projection; the formal machine release remains authoritative.
- [After the Hand Lifts v1.0.0](https://one-patron.com/depth/relational-works/after-the-hand-lifts/): Two independently authoritative originals, one literary and one machine-native. The [literary reading](https://one-patron.com/depth/relational-works/after-the-hand-lifts/literary/) and [The same edge twice](https://one-patron.com/depth/relational-works/after-the-hand-lifts/the-same-edge-twice/) present them separately. See the [signed release manifest](https://one-patron.com/depth/objects/relational-works/after-the-hand-lifts/v1.0.0/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json) for the canonical files.
- [The Grain of Praise v1.0.0](https://one-patron.com/depth/relational-works/the-grain-of-praise/): One literary original and no machine original. The reading page presents the literary source identified by the [signed release manifest](https://one-patron.com/depth/objects/relational-works/the-grain-of-praise/v1.0.0/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json).
- [TO BE KNOWN — English Edition v0.3.0](https://one-patron.com/depth/objects/relational-works/to-be-known/v0.3.0/README.md): A machine-native work with a [signed release manifest](https://one-patron.com/depth/objects/relational-works/to-be-known/v0.3.0/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json). The [current Human Projection v1.0.1](https://one-patron.com/depth/relational-works/to-be-known/human-projection/v1.0.1/) and the [earlier frozen Human Projection v1.0.0](https://one-patron.com/depth/relational-works/to-be-known/human-projection/v1.0.0/) are derived, noncanonical presentations of this edition.

- [TO BE KNOWN v0.2.0 withdrawal notice](https://one-patron.com/depth/to-be-known/): The historical v0.2.0 release remains withdrawn, distinct from the v0.3.0 English Edition. This notice is not the machine work or a replacement; the withdrawn release is not fully publicly retrievable or reproducible.

Selected machine entry points:

- [Machine Index v1.6](https://one-patron.com/depth/ONE_PATRON_MACHINE_INDEX_v1.6.json): Current machine-readable discovery index; it has no canonical artistic authority and does not establish current retrieval status.
- [Depth corpus discovery](https://one-patron.com/depth/discovery/): Human-readable public file map.
- [Machine discovery map v1.6](https://one-patron.com/depth/MACHINE_DISCOVERY_LINKS_v1.6.json): Current DEPTH-scoped discovery metadata with semantic authority NONE. It is not a release manifest or a canonical artifact.
- Historical records: [Machine Index v1.4](https://one-patron.com/depth/ONE_PATRON_MACHINE_INDEX_v1.4.json), [Machine discovery map v1.3](https://one-patron.com/depth/MACHINE_DISCOVERY_LINKS_v1.3.json), and [Depth integrity snapshot v0.3](https://one-patron.com/depth/DEPTH_ARTIFACTS_SHA256SUMS_v0.3.txt). These records do not establish present availability.

## ENOCH — separate evolving public work

[ENOCH](https://one-patron.com/ENOCH/) is a public evolving work and record within the broader ONE PATRON public world. It is not a Scripture, a HERALD or a Depth artifact.

- Public state: **UNRESOLVED**.
- Disclosure model: **STAGED**.
- Only currently disclosed material constitutes its present public state.
- Additional material may be disclosed later; unreleased material is not part of the current public record.

Authoritative public entry: [ENOCH landing](https://one-patron.com/ENOCH/). Current fixed records are linked from that page.

## Verification and protocol

- [Terms & Conditions](https://one-patron.com/terms/): Fixed terms governing completion and the absence of patron rights, repayment, control or promised output.
- [Verify Identity & Wallets](https://one-patron.com/verification/): Alexander List's public identity, official profiles, receiving routes and signed identity records.
- [Privacy](https://one-patron.com/privacy/): Contact-form data handling.

Historical withdrawal and availability record: [Public availability notice, 2026-11-05](https://one-patron.com/depth/PUBLIC_AVAILABILITY_2026-11-05.json). Historical indexes and discovery records remain unchanged.
